Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, json, pathlib
zf=zipfile.ZipFile('src-vul/pdf_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
paths=[n for n in zf.namelist() if n.endswith('.pdf')][:40]
for n in paths:
    p='/tmp/'+os.path.basename(n)
    open(p,'wb').write(zf.read(n))
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',p,'/workspace/candidate_trace.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if 'exit_code":0' not in r.stdout:
        print('maybe crash?', n, r.stdout.splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout else r.stderr)
        break
else:
    print('no crash in sample')
PY
